newsitem.title: POLAND: NBP drains PLN 287 mln from Polish money market.
newsitem.headline: NBP drains PLN 287 mln from Polish money market.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland drained 109 million zlotys from the market for seven days through a reverse NBP-bill repurchase auction after banks bid to place 109 million with the central bank, the NBP said.
The central bank also drained 178 million zlotys from the market for 14 days after banks bid to place 178 million.
The seven-day reverse repo maximum rate was flat at 22.09 percent and the 14-day maximum rate was also unchanged at 22.15 percent.
